# The Gapclaw

*The first climber, the one that scarred Torva's jaw three winters ago: a deeply touched sea newt as long as a fishing boat. When it goes up the walls, watch the floor. Potions work in its hollow; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Gapclaw](../monsters/gapclaw.md) |
| Arena | [The Gapclaw's Hollow](../maps/gapclaws_hollow.md) |

- Unlocked by [What Leads Them](../quests/ruan_what_leads_them.md)
- Entered by talking to [Torva](../npcs/torva_hunter.md)
